adversarial_review.page_eligibility: Sampling reads all WARN/FAIL findings in frozen data.json, not per-dataset pages. Missing pages cannot silently remove rows; the test runs the sampler with no page directory.
adversarial_review.revision_drift: All 35 selected Hub dataset IDs resolved to the exact row commit; source metadata and available object IDs are frozen. Four RLDS cases have only non-immutable GCS stamps and stay unresolved. Main's engine 01fb98a42eb7 differs from the board's f9a1edd38b66; no main rerun adjudicates a stored row.
adversarial_review.selection_bias: Two-per-check and FAIL fill overrepresent rare checks and FAIL findings; distinct-dataset preference changes prevalence. The two bridge task-string rows appear to be mirrors, so 39 dataset IDs are not 39 independent sources. No population precision estimate is claimed.
adversarial_review.shared_assumptions: Raw probes use source info.json path templates and published episode IDs to locate targets, but never kinema detection helpers. Metadata can be stale: the OpenGraph case was cross-checked against raw parquet. Heuristic arithmetic and source stats alone are not treated as proof of a defect.
adversarial_review.weak_labels: The structural regression pack and corpus influenced development and cannot estimate misses. Most heuristic warnings lack video or task context. The one false alarm rejects the motor interpretation of a static quaternion component while preserving the static signal.

miss_exercise.development_influence: All structural cases were selected, trimmed and checked during detector development. The adjudicated corpus is also a regression guard for known cases. Neither is held out.
miss_exercise.held_out_search: Reviewed tests/data/structural, tests/data/corpus and network regression cases in tests/test_real_datasets.py; each contains development-known cases or labels derived from prior kinema work. No genuinely independent, pinned broken and matched clean holdout was established in this phase.
miss_exercise.scope: separate known-fixture miss exercise; not independent benchmark

sampling_frame.exclusions: Only INFO, PASS and SKIP findings excluded; no WARN/FAIL rows excluded for absent dataset pages
